Environment flags `production: true` and `access: read-only | read-write` (read-only by default in production).

Read-only enforcement by request interception in the browser context: mutating requests (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE, GraphQL mutations) to the environment hosts are blocked except allow-listed patterns; a blocked request either fails or is answered by a configured mock so the flow continues on screen.

Writing hooks are refused on read-only environments; writing in production needs `access: read-write` in the project AND `--allow-writes` at run time (explicit confirmation in the Studio app); run.json/timeline record the access mode and review shows it.
